name: KP Energy Ltd
tagline: KP-group wind BoP/EPC contractor plus a small IPP - FY26 PAT ~Rs 181 Cr (ATH) at ~9x earnings, but Q1 FY27 showed revenue +126-137% YoY translate to PAT +~3% as rising right-of-way/input costs compressed margins and FY27 guidance was cut to 30-40%; order book is now confirmed ~50/50 group-vs-non-group (less captive than the thread feared), but margin volatility is the fresh overhang
business_overview: KP Energy Ltd (BSE/NSE: KPEL), part of the KP group (Faruk Patel), develops utility-scale wind power infrastructure: wind-site siting, land and permits, EPCC, and balance-of-plant (BoP). It also owns and operates WTGs and a solar plant as an IPP (~48.5 MW: 37 MW wind + 11.5 MW solar, including a 28.6 MW Vagra wind IPP commissioned on time and on budget), targeting ~100 MW by FY27.
fundamentals_table: Revenue ~Rs 520 Cr (+126-137% YoY) but PAT only ~Rs 26 Cr (+~3% YoY, PBT +8%) - gross margin fell to ~20% from ~28% QoQ on rising right-of-way (ROW) and supply-chain input costs
~8.65x trailing P/E; ~5.5x EV/EBITDA; ~1x sales - all below their own 5-yr median

~2.16 GW / ~Rs 2,250 Cr (Jun 2026) - down from ~Rs 3,086 Cr (Jun 2025) as execution has outpaced fresh order intake; ~50% from group co KPI Green, ~50% non-related (explicitly disclosed at the Q1 FY27 concall)
Cut mid-year to ~30-40% revenue growth (from a higher initial internal target), CFO citing Gujarat right-of-way costs and farmer-protest execution risk
CARE upgraded (Oct 2025) citing scale, ~Rs 3,086 Cr order book (Jun 2025) and on-time/on-budget delivery of the 28.6 MW Vagra wind IPP
2026-05-08: Q4FY26 sales +58% YoY to Rs 632 Cr; net profit +72% YoY to Rs 79 Cr; OPM 18% -> 21%; QoQ sales +83%, PAT +93%
Guided ~Rs 2,500 Cr revenue / ~Rs 275-300 Cr PAT; delivered ~Rs 1,505 Cr / ~Rs 181 Cr - a large miss (still ~60% growth)
fundamentals_narrative: KP Energy screens cheap and fast-growing: FY26 revenue ~Rs 1,505 Cr, PAT ~Rs 181 Cr (record), ~8.65x earnings, ~5.5x EV/EBITDA, and a ~2.16 GW / ~Rs 2,250 Cr order book against a real wind-capex tailwind. The ValuePickr thread (12355) flagged a persistent discount for captive-EPC-arm dependence on group company KPI Green; the Q1 FY27 concall (Aug 2026) put an actual number on that for the first time - order book is ~50% KPI Green / ~50% non-related, less one-sided than the thread's 'most of the order book' framing, though still a material single-customer-group exposure. The bigger fresh finding this pass is on margin quality, not RPT: Q1 FY27 revenue surged +126-137% YoY to ~Rs 520 Cr, but PAT grew only ~3% to ~Rs 26 Cr as gross margin fell to ~20% from ~28% QoQ on rising right-of-way (ROW) costs and supply-chain input-cost shocks - growth and profit decoupled for the first time in the disclosed quarterly series. Management proactively cut FY27 revenue-growth guidance to 30-40% (from a higher initial target), citing the same ROW costs plus farmer protests in Gujarat - a second consecutive guidance disappointment, though this time flagged in real time rather than delivered as a silent miss. Offsetting this, CARE Ratings upgraded KP Energy's credit rating in Oct 2025, citing scale/order-book visibility and flawless on-time, on-budget execution of the 28.6 MW Vagra wind IPP - a concrete execution proof point. Promoter holding stable at ~45.3-45.4% with zero pledge (confirmed across sources) - a historical concern (down from ~69% in 2020), not a live collapse. No formal red flag; RPT dependence (now better quantified, less severe than feared) and margin-execution risk (newly surfaced) are the two live reasons the multiple stays at ~9x.

value_chain.theme: Wind power - balance-of-plant / EPC + small IPP
value_chain.position: Wind-site development, EPCC and balance-of-plant contractor (does not supply the turbines - customers order WTGs directly); also a ~48.5 MW wind+solar IPP targeting ~100 MW by FY27
value_chain.bottleneck_node: Wind-site pipeline (land, permits, evacuation, right-of-way) and execution bandwidth; turbine supply and financing sit with the customer. Q1 FY27 showed ROW cost inflation itself can become a margin bottleneck, not just a volume one.
value_chain.note: India's wind build-out (RE targets, repowering, hybrid tenders) is a genuine multi-year tailwind. KP Energy's BoP/EPC niche is real and its order book is now confirmed only ~50% (not 'most') sourced from group company KPI Green, with a clean execution track record (Vagra IPP on time/budget) backing the Oct-2025 CARE rating upgrade - a real, if partial, execution moat. But BoP/EPC remains a competitively bid, commoditised, working-capital-heavy activity, and Q1 FY27's margin compression shows pricing/cost risk survives even with a healthy order book.

verdict_headline: Cheap, fast-growing wind BoP/EPC contractor whose order book is less captive-to-KPI-Green than feared (~50/50, not 'most'), but Q1 FY27 exposed a real margin-execution risk (revenue +126% YoY, PAT +~3%) that now shares the discount-justification role with RPT dependence - four_box firms to 3.0 (moat weak-not-no) yet conviction held at Low-Medium pending 2-3 quarters of margin clarity
verdict_reasoning: Sovrenn-news seed (tier 4.65). The Sovrenn trigger (Q4FY26 sales +58% YoY, PAT +72%, OPM 18% -> 21%) holds up and FY26 PAT is a record ~Rs 181 Cr. Per the trailing-vs-live rule: strong trajectory + a ~2.16 GW order book + a cheap small-cap -> 10x-in-2-3-years, now supported mechanically too: four_box score moved from 2.5 to 3.0 this pass (moat upgraded no->weak on the Q1 FY27 concall's explicit ~50/50 RPT disclosure and the CARE-cited Vagra IPP execution track record), so the label is permitted on the >=3.0 row without needing the unconfirmed-exception language.

Deep-dive pass 1 (2026-09-22) found two offsetting updates versus the sovrenn-seed read. Positive: the order book is only ~50% KPI Green, not 'most' as the thread implied, and CARE upgraded the credit rating (Oct 2025) on a clean 28.6 MW Vagra IPP execution track record - rpt_trend downgraded from 'concerning' to 'unclear' (no real trend data, just a better first data point) and guidance_credibility from 'over-promises' to 'mixed' (FY27's guide-down was proactive, not a silent miss). Negative and new: Q1 FY27 (Jun 2026) revenue surged +126-137% YoY but PAT grew only ~3% as gross margin fell 28%->20% QoQ on ROW/input-cost shocks - the first quarter where growth and profit have decoupled - and FY27 growth guidance was cut to 30-40%. This is now a real, demonstrated reason for the ~9x multiple, not just a perceived RPT-dependence discount.

Net: conviction held at Low-Medium (not raised despite the four_box improvement, not cut despite the margin miss) - the two updates roughly offset. Promoter holding ~45% (down from ~69% in 2020 after a co-promoter exit) has been stable since - a historical concern, not a live collapse, so no HIGH CAUTION tier. No SEBI/auditor issue found. conviction_score/master_score etc. are owned by the automated pipeline, not touched here. Re-check on Q2/Q3 FY27 prints for whether the ROW/cost-shock margin compression proves transient, and on any further order-book RPT-mix disclosure.

track_record.note: Screener FY18-FY26: rev growth >=10% AND ROCE >=15% both cleared in 4 of 9 (FY22 247%/44%, FY23 75%/38%, FY25 99%/39%, FY26 60%/39%). Misses are mostly lumpy wind-EPC revenue timing (FY18 -46%, FY21 -4%, FY24 +8%) or an early low-ROCE year (FY19 7%); ROCE has been 38-44% in every delivery year since FY22. Unaffected by this pass (annual-cadence metric); Q1 FY27's margin compression is a quarterly, not yet annual, signal.

quality_metrics.note: Wind-EPC / balance-of-plant with a deliberate shift into owned IPP + O&M annuity. ROCE 38-42% FY23-26 (independent sources this pass show ROE ~49% / ROCE ~37%, consistent). OPM 18%->19%->21% through FY24-26, but Q1 FY27 gross margin fell back to ~20% from ~28% QoQ on ROW/input-cost shocks - margin_trend downgraded from 'expanding' to 'unclear' this pass given that reversal; through-cycle level now genuinely uncertain pending 2-3 more quarters. Net debt/EBITDA ~1.0-1.4x depending on source/quarter (moderate, funding IPP capex); FY26 borrowings ~Rs442cr vs ~Rs314cr EBITDA. Trailing-3y FCF conversion ~-36% (CFO Rs318cr vs capex Rs523cr FY24-26) - the negative gap is the deliberate build-out of owned wind assets; ROCE holding ~37-39% through the spend, so capex still reads productive (also supported by CARE's on-time/on-budget Vagra IPP execution note, Oct 2025).

market_expectation.implied_growth_cagr: ~8.65x trailing P/E still prices a sharp slowdown / execution risk, but Q1 FY27's margin miss gives the market genuine cover for that discount now, not just perceived RPT-dependence; even a modest EPS CAGR would justify a materially higher multiple for a ~39% ROCE business if margins stabilise
market_expectation.our_fy27_estimate: revenue +30-40% (management's own cut guidance) on the wind-EPC order book + rising IPP/O&M annuity; margin trajectory is now the swing factor after Q1 FY27's gross-margin compression (28%->20%) - if ROW/input costs prove transient, OPM should recover toward high-teens/~20% and PAT growth resumes double-digit; if not, PAT growth stays well below revenue growth as it did in Q1
market_expectation.our_fy28_estimate: annuity mix (owned wind IPP + O&M, targeting 100 MW) still lifts through-cycle quality, but FY28 now depends on FY27 margin recovery from the Q1 ROW/cost shock - capex funding, ROW cost trajectory, and order-book replenishment (order book itself has shrunk YoY, Rs 3,086cr Jun25 -> Rs 2,250cr Jun26, as execution has outpaced fresh intake) are the key watch items
